# Server Rules
## 1. All players must be 18+ Due to the lack of content restrictions, there is a possibility of encountering mature themes on this server. Because of this, minors are strictly forbidden from playing on this server. If you are suspected of being a minor you may be removed until you are of age.
## 2. TOS and Legality Notice You are expected to adhere to your local laws, as well as the local laws of the server host in Texas. Do not use this server to conduct illegal activities, those caught may be reported to relevant authorities.
You are also expected to adhere to Steam, Discord, and Space Wizards Terms of Service. These include forbidding harassing players or other communities, history of grooming, piracy, cheating, etc.
Breaches of this rule will result in a ban.
## 3. Hate Speech Since its not covered by Rule 2, I am stating here that racism, sexism, queerphobia, ableism, or generally being a dick is not allowed OOCly. You can play whatever character you want, however certain modern phrases will result in an auto-mute if they're attempted to be said.
These won't result in an in-game ban, but could get you banned from the discord.
# FAQ
## How do I begin? After you click accept, you'll be given the ability to make your first character. This will be the only character you're allowed until you accumulate 20hrs of playtime and unlock an additional character slot.
If this character dies, you're free to delete up to 1 character every 20 hours and make another, in order to prevent raiding. This also means you need to value your life, you're at the mercy of the community to be revived, so maybe don't make your first character a total asshole.
## Where is the MRP/HRP at? To get involved with the HRP side of the server, you must join a corportation, such as NanoTrasen. Each corp has its own rules and expectations, and could terminate you at will.
Each corp has unique benefits for joining, such as access to cloning if your character perishes and can't be recovered. However, expectations aren't always just RP level, you may also need to be online to work shifts at scheduled times.
## What about the NRP/LRP side? Public space is the NRP/LRP zone. You can buy and fly your own ship, grind money to upgrade it, improve your character, and generally enjoy the gameplay loop.
At any point, you're also free to interact with corps and stations who will treat you accordingly based on your behavior. Most stations have large guns and can blow you out of the sky if you threaten them, so while attempting a raid isn't against any rules, its ill advised.
## What happens when I log off? Your character remains just like with normal SS14. After an hour, you'll be automatically cryo'd to save server resources.
If you return after being cryo'd, your character is loaded in the chamber they were last at. Timers like for health and hunger keep running even while logged off or cryo'd.
